clauses.title: CL-D129 records the presence-and-type inventory and closes CL-D119's divergence
requires: each entry records its path and its type (`dir`, `file`, `symlink`, `other` or `absent`), never a file's hash or a link's target
This closes the divergence CL-D119 recorded.

clauses.title: The inventory records a file and a link by type alone
requires: // without following a link, never its content (CL-D38, CL-D129).

clauses.title: CL-D38, CL-D93 and CL-D119 point forward to this record
The suite asserts the inventory, both drivers and the record
